mapper.insert: INSERT INTO withdrawal ( account_id, requested_amount, destination_account_no, destination_general_account_id, processed_at, status ) VALUES( #{accountId}, #{requestedAmount}, #{destinationAccountNo}, #{destinationGeneralAccountId}, #{processedAt}, #{status} )

INSERT INTO withdrawal_allocation( withdrawal_id, left_amount_id, allocated_amount, withdrawal_at, type )VALUES( #{withdrawalId}, #{leftAmountId}, #{allocatedAmount}, #{withdrawalAt}, #{type}
)
mapper.select: SELECT la.left_amount_id, la.exchange_id, la.cur_amount, ke.final_at FROM left_amount la JOIN krw_exchange ke on la.exchange_id=ke.exchange_id WHERE ke.account_id = #{accountId} AND ke.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND ke.final_at IS NOT NULL AND la.cur_amount > 0 ORDER BY ke.final_at ASC, ke.exchange_id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount), 0) FROM withdrawal_allocation WHERE withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} AND type = 'IMMATURE_PRINCIPAL_INCLUDED'
mapper.sql: SELECT w.withdrawal_id, w.account_id, c.name AS customer_name, a.account_no AS ria_account_no, w.requested_amount, w.processed_at, w.destination_account_no, w.destination_general_account_id, w.status, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN wa.type = 'EARNINGS_ONLY' THEN wa.allocated_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS earnings_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN wa.type = 'MATURED_PRINCIPAL_INCLUDED' THEN wa.allocated_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS matured_principal_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN wa.type = 'IMMATURE_PRINCIPAL_INCLUDED' THEN wa.allocated_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS immature_principal_amount FROM withdrawal w JOIN account a ON a.account_id = w.account_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN withdrawal_allocation wa ON wa.withdrawal_id = w.withdrawal_id
GROUP BY w.withdrawal_id, w.account_id, c.name, a.account_no, w.requested_amount, w.processed_at, w.destination_account_no, w.destination_general_account_id, w.status
mapper.select:
WHERE w.status = #{status}
ORDER BY w.processed_at DESC, w.withdrawal_id DESC

WHERE w.account_id = #{accountId}
ORDER BY w.processed_at DESC, w.withdrawal_id DESC

SELECT wa.allocation_id, wa.left_amount_id, la.exchange_id, wa.allocated_amount, wa.withdrawal_at, wa.type, ke.final_at, fp.name AS product_name, fp.ticker FROM withdrawal_allocation wa LEFT JOIN left_amount la ON la.left_amount_id = wa.left_amount_id LEFT JOIN krw_exchange ke ON ke.exchange_id = la.exchange_id LEFT JOIN sell_order so ON so.order_id = ke.order_id LEFT JOIN foreign_product fp ON fp.foreign_product_id = so.foreign_product_id WHERE wa.withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} ORDER BY wa.allocation_id ASC
